name: Reign of the Pit
oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way.
blocked_sentences: Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way.

needs.what: an X/X black Demon creature token with flying (power and toughness set on creation by create_token's power/toughness)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no black Demon with flying of variable size: vampire_demon_4_3_wb_flying is a fixed 4/3 white-black Vampire Demon, and the X/X flying tokens (shark_x_x_u_flying, dragon_illusion_x_x_r_flying_haste) are the wrong colour and creature type. The sacrifice half is expressible (for_each_player + sacrifice with snapshot/as, X read via power_had summed), so only the token blocks the card
